newsitem.title: JAMAICA: Air Jamaica sets Montego Bay hub.
newsitem.headline: Air Jamaica sets Montego Bay hub.

text.p: Air Jamaica Monday said it plans to convert Montego Bay's international airport into its hub within three months, linking its flights between North America, Europe and the Caribbean.

Chairman Gordon "Butch" Stewart said the new hub arrangements would begin on June 15. The airline's flights from a number of U.S., Canadian and British destinations will now converge on Montego Bay, where onward connections to Barbados, the Bahamas, Cayman Islands, Cuba, St. Lucia, Antigua and the Turks & Caicos Islands can be made.
The arrangement would put Air Jamaica in direct competition with AMR Corp unit American Airlines's Puerto Rico hub.
Stewart said the acquisition of a new fleet of six Airbus Industrie A310s and four A320s, and a soon-to-commence US$100 million upgrading of the airport would make the proposal "more feasible."
